node.label: Treasury issuance & buybacks
node.up: The government is selling more debt than buyers want at today's price
node.what: How much new government debt is being sold, and whether the Treasury is buying old bonds back. This board cannot measure it — there is no daily series for it — so it sits here as a named cause with no number, and the only honest way to read it is through what the 30-year does next.
